name: RoadOut
summary:
The world is dominated by an A.I. and rebel groups take refuge in a desert area known as the DeadZone.

Claire survives by executing delivery, sabotage and murder contracts for local leaders, while discovering about her past, revealing strange evidence that links her existence with the origin of the A.I.

name: Girl.exe
summary: You and your friends go to another world because you wanted to find a girlfriend. And you found one.... There is one crazy girl in this world. Will you be able to get out of this world or will you stay with her forever?

name: Underling Uprising
summary: Play as the Underlings, a group of experiments created by evil mad science, as you seek revenge on your previous captor, the maniacal Dr. Baldrick! On their journey, the Underlings will need to fight across the globe, overcome the demons of their pasts, and accept help from unexpected places.

name: The Clubies
summary: The Clubies is a party platformer where players navigate cute cube characters through the disco to reach the dancefloor! Encounter various hazards, puzzles, and shortcuts in a fun, colorful environment as you master user-built levels together.

name: Whirlight: No Time To Trip
summary: In the heart of Verice Bay, a brilliant idea takes shape in the hands of an eccentric inventor and an eclectic artist. Follow Margaret and Hector in a point-and-click graphic adventure that will take you to the edge of space and time to help them avert imminent danger.

name: A Tale of Silent Depths
summary: A Tale of Silent Depths is a turn based tactical RPG set in a post-apocalyptic underwater setting. Explore a procedurally generated Ocean, command your submarine and fight beasts, pirates and creatures beyond your crew's comprehension.

name: Find Us Cats
summary: Find Us Cats is a new hidden object game starring our favorite feline companions! Find dozens of cats in each level and aim for a high score in Level 1 of our free demo, the Planetarium.

name: Creepy Tale: Snow Child
summary: A volatile cocktail of action and puzzles, spiced with pitch-black humor and a deliciously sinister atmosphere. Journey into Hell alongside a brave boy named Blizzy and defeat Evil itself. Save the world and become a hero. But at what cost?

name: Alchemist: Journey of the Soul
summary: First-person adventure game, playable solo or co-op with up to 4 people. Travel through unique areas, uncover memories and use them to craft powerful potions. Unlock special abilities and solve puzzles in a mysterious world. Will your soul survive this journey?

name: American Truck Simulator: Illinois
summary: Welcome to the beautiful Prairie State! Illinois showcases the best of what the USA has to offer. Hop into your rig, hit the legendary Route 66, and journey through Springfield, the state’s historic capital, to Chicago, one of the Midwest's most iconic cities.

name: Nova Patria
summary: Nova Patria is a Roman Steampunk Colony Sim. In this alternate history, the empire never fell and lived on to discover the New World and steam power. Manage intricate supply chains, expanding cities, and innovations in a hopeful, procedurally generated, isometric simulation of industrial antiquity.

name: Taste of Blood
summary: A real-time strategy game with a simple economy, designed so you can focus on the battle and crush your enemies.

name: Mysteries of Old Tokyo
summary: Step into the Imperial Capital, where knowledge is your weapon. Research and explore 40+ real-life Tokyo locations, past and present. Encounter a cast of wandering spirits, interrogate their stories, and separate the truth from their lies.

name: Port Authority
summary: Port Authority is a real-time harbor management game where you draw routes guiding cargo ships to color-matched docks. Navigate increasingly chaotic traffic through harbors inspired by real-world locations as more vessels arrive. One collision ends it all. How many containers can you deliver?

name: Case Files: Internal Affairs
summary: The 3rd installment in the Case Files series. An FMV murder mystery, police interrogation, detective experience.

name: Let Me Play!
summary: After shouting "Let Me Play!" to the cast in a theatre, the fiction comes crashing down as everyone, including you, becomes aware they're only following a script. Will you let the play continue? Or will you write your own ending?

name: Wall Street Raider
summary: Wall Street Raider offers the deepest stock market simulations in gaming history. Control publicly traded corporations, futures, options, and even crypto. Whether you want to make billions in equities, short-sell overvalued stocks, or hedge risk using derivatives, the market is yours to conquer!

name: The Melty Way
summary: You move, you melt. Play as a brave size-shifting slime in this colorful precision puzzle-platformer, dashing through handcrafted puzzles and perilous traps on your journey in The Melty Way.

name: Maze Creep!!
summary: A satire co-op horror game where players aim to reach the end of an infinite series of mazes, evading the all-hearing Maze Creep and various other threats.

name: Panzer Corps 2: Allied Operations - Italy: Vol.1
summary: Lead the Allied invasion of Sicily in the opening chapter of a grand trilogy. Command British and American forces across two converging campaigns, carry your veteran core army forward, and relive the historic push that broke open Fortress Europe.

name: King Crab
summary: Dig trenches, build walls, explore the beach, and defend your sandcastle from the rising tide - on PC or in VR.

name: Do Not Feed the Virus
summary: Grow your organism, gather biomass, and expand your colony. A casual, mouse-driven incremental game focused on growth and progression.

name: What'Sub
summary: Work together as a pirate crew and plunder coffee across the oceans! Hold your (t)rusty submarine together, dodge disasters, fight dangers, and finally get the black gold home! Play this co-op action game with up to 4 players and try become the mightiest pirates of the underseas!

name: Tohotopia
summary: A 4X strategy craze sweeps Gensokyo! As the "Esports Tournament" begins, the girls join the fray. Warlords rise: will you be "Pharaoh" Remilia, "Emperor" Kaguya, "Great" Kanako, or "Philosopher King" Miko? Launch the game now, lead your empire, and dominate Gensokyo!

name: The Caribou Trail
summary: The WWI story where your goal isn't to kill, but to survive. In the still trenches, three soldiers learn the harsh truth of war: reckless missions, digging trenches, collecting dog tags and ghostly whispers in the dark. Home before the leaves fall, they thought.

name: Drifters Don't Brake: Midnight
summary: Drift through different terrains and tackle challenges while your car auto-accelerates nonstop.

name: CaseCracker3
summary: Sift crucial evidence from a sea of data. Reconstruct the case from fragmented narratives. Catch logical gaps hidden between the lines. Unearth the truth from the faintest traces! Youll need sharp logic and keen insight to conquer this fully immersive deduction challenge. Come onIm waiting.

name: Mineral Mining Simulator
summary: Turns raw rock into valuable minerals and jewelry grade gemstones through a hands on production chain. Mine ore, crush it into fragments, refine it, and scale your operation with better machines and smarter workflow. Optimize every stage of the pipeline to maximize efficiency, quality, and profit.

name: Luna's Room
summary: An unfamiliar room. Vague memories. Explore Luna's room through the objects inside it in this intimate narrative experience about loss, told as a classic-style graphic adventure.

name: Company of Heroes 3: Dare & Destroy
summary: Company of Heroes 3: Dare & Destroy is a Battlegroup DLC pack consisting of four Battlegroups for Multiplayer and Co-Op/ Skirmish vs AI.

name: Make Way: Legends Pack
summary: Stylishly smash the competition with the Legends Pack!

name: Snack and Quack: Duckling Steps
summary: Quack, Push, and Feed the Ducklings

name: Solo Shift!
summary: From cash register to fryer—you've got to manage it all! Take on waves of customers all by yourself! Run a convenience store solo in this frantic action game!

name: Colorizing: Daylight
summary: Coloring by numbers game for relaxation

name: Crayon Farm Animals
summary: My child's first digital sketchbook, color in the colorful farm animals! Complete cute cow, horse, and sheep friends with my fingertips, and fill your own animal picture book.

name: Tindark
summary:
Tindark is a loop-style psychological horror puzzle game where players take on the role of a dating-app user tasked with spotting anomalies among their daily matches.

Each day, eight profiles must be reviewed — swipe right on normal profiles, swipe left on anomalies. Reach Day 9 without making a mistake to escape the loop. Inspired by anomaly-spotting horror titles such as The Exit 8, a single playthrough lasts roughly 15 to 60 minutes.

name: Ignore the Blackbird
summary: Ignore the Blackbird is a hand-drawn watercolor puzzle game. Explore the greenhouse, solve puzzles woven into its surroundings, and uncover what happened to Sonya and her family.

name: Menace from the Deep: Complete Edition
summary: Menace from the Deep is a roguelike deckbuilder, set in myth-soaked 1920s USA, where cults and eldritch horrors lurk beneath the surface.

name: Furry Necromancer
summary: You died, but I got good news and bad news for you. The good news - you have been resurrected, the bad news - you have been resurrected by a necromancer who has some "special" plans for you (although it might not be "bad news" at all...)

name: The Adventures of Sir Kicksalot
summary: A first-person action game that provides various ways for defeating your foes, whether through weaponry, magic, stealth, or clever tactics like kicking into deadly spikes.

name: Shattered Divinities
summary: In Shattered Divinities, embark on an adventure that pits you directly against divinity itself! An ancient War of Gods shattered the world, and their broken power has become the Calamities that consume all life. How will you survive in this land? And how will you uncover the secrets behind the War?

name: The Sintonia Chronicles
summary: Join Maria on an unforgettable journey through the world of Sintonia to rescue her beloved pups. Forge unlikely alliances, face epic bosses, and outsmart every challenge in a universe brimming with magic and adventure.

name: The Island of Doctor Morose
summary: A horror adventure game inspired by the art of Theodor Geisel and the works of HP Lovecraft, featuring a mixture of point and click and survival horror elements.

name: Down with the Ship
summary: Strategic auto battler where you design a heavily-armed spaceship. Draft 200+ items, outfit your hull, and unleash it in async PvP. Blend captains and factions for absurd combos and galactic domination. Roll, buy, place, pray.

name: Augment Anthem
summary: A 2D sci-fi metroidvania. Explore Bunker 7, fight biomechanical threats shaped by corrupted superintelligence, and rebuild Haven, humanity's final refuge.

name: Boogie Fungi
summary: Build and maintain a colony of Mushrooms, keep them happy with constant parties and make sure to deploy some defenses to deal with foragers

name: Pandora's Toybox
summary: Pandora's Toybox combines god simulation and Roguelike elements. Players guide humanity from settlements to city-states, shaping a faith-driven civilization. As Epimetheus, use divine powers to combat heretical beliefs and build a thriving, devout society in a randomly generated, chaotic world.

name: Cat Island Petrichor
summary: "Cat Island Petricolor" is an exploration adventure game set on Japan's summer "Cat Island." Become a cat, explore the island, and uncover the mysteries of Cat Island together with the heroine!

name: Closure
summary: An experimental narrative game that tells its story through sound and memory. Sort through a box of personal momentos and relive memories from a seven-year relationship by closing you eyes in real life.

name: Steel Artery: Train City Builder
summary: Build a living city on rails in this steampunk fantasy train-city builder. Manage multiracial colonies with thousands of autonomous citizens, balance their needs, manage the economy, and create logistics as you explore distant regions to ensure the prosperity of your Empire.

name: Deathplane
summary: Deathplane is a 2D puzzle-platformer game about moving the actual deathplane below the level up and down to kill enemies and find solutions and secrets.

name: SubZero
summary: A frozen apocalypse. Three unique survivors join you. Lead them through the icy wasteland! Zombie whispers, blizzards blur morality... Hope or doom? The fateful die burns in your grip.

name: Deliria
summary: Fight, build, and conquer wonders in a thrilling infinite 3D sandbox. An adventure without cubes! Play solo or with friends in PvP, co-op, or creative mode—backed by 20+ original soundtracks.

name: Futa Fucks Femboys
summary: Futa Fucks Femboys is an explosive mix of 2D Visual Novel and Collectible Card Game, where an alien symbiote turns the main hero into a FUTANARI and drags her into an adventure full of passion, absurdity, and FEMBOYS. Saving Earth has never felt so spicy

name: Midnight Kebab
summary: We start working as a chef in a kebab shop where employees constantly quit or mysteriously disappear. As we work, we begin to understand the disturbing reason why people become obsessively dependent only inside the restaurant.

name: Drive Together
summary: One car, many drivers! Team up with your friends and share control of the gas, brakes, and steering to reach the finish line through chaotic tracks. Will it be perfect teamwork, or a total disaster? (Playable with 1–4 players)

name: Boba Buba
summary: BobaBuba Is the Boba Bubble-Pop Puzzle Adventure with story mode featuring cute beverages and an endless mode for huge replay value. With global leaderboards from launch!

name: Pintorino
summary: Ready to challenge your brain? Pintorino is a grid-based puzzle game where you guide a player across the board, aiming to pass through all the required blocks - each with its own unique purpose.

name: Galaxy Grinder Incremental
summary: Galaxy Grinder is a fast-paced incremental game where you destroy planets and asteroids with your cursor and weapons. Earn resources, unlock new worlds, and grow stronger through upgrades, skills, and power-ups between runs.

name: Platyguard: Swarm Slayer
summary: PlatyGuard: Swarm Slayer is a 2D action roguelike platformer RPG set in a post-apocalyptic wasteland, infused with biopunk and dark sci-fi flair. Survive the chaos, clash with mutant foes, and explore mysterious sites in this indie adventure!

name: Mewlin the Clicker
summary: Click to roll the crystal ball across the table, dodging obstacles and facing bosses while building a deck of cards that completely changes your strategy with every run. Help Mewlin, a very curious orange cat, make a total mess in this magical clicker with deckbuilding elements.

name: The Curse of Womanland
summary: A romance-adventure text-based game themed around the Land of Women. You will travel to the Land of Women, meet the mysterious young lady Jian Ling, and gradually uncover the bloody and dark secrets behind this realm. Death, resistance, or degeneration? Everything depends on your choices.

name: Centipede Simulator
summary: Experience life as a centipede! Munch on crickets to grow longer and evade deadly predators in a frantic struggle for survival across multiple game modes. How long can you last?

name: Nano Squadron
summary: Nano Squadron is a top-down space roguelite where your nanobot ship evolves mid-battle. Survive relentless alien waves, stack powerful upgrades, and build a ship capable of defending Earth.

name: Psychic Kung Fu Master
summary: CRPG gameplay, turn-based combat, collect martial arts to become the leader of the martial world, recruit disciples, cultivate martial skills, and compete for supremacy in the world.

name: Overdrive Reloaded
summary: Overdrive Reloaded is a single player first-person shooter created by Dynamite Games. Drop into a stunning reimagining of the series, built from the ground up with relentless PvE combat, action-packed Arena modes, open world Battle Royale, and an all-new progression system known as Evolution.

name: Entiled
summary: Entiled is a spatial tile-clearing puzzle game where every move matters. Remove tiles without collisions, match the active color to build your multiplier, and trigger chain reactions to maximize your score in quick, replayable runs.

name: Ace Thunder: Aircraft Wingman Simulator
summary: Precision in flight. Power in combat.

name: Sky Meadow
summary: Drift into a peaceful world above the clouds.

name: Rugrats: Retro Rewind Collection
summary:
Hold onto your diapers! Rugrats: Retro Rewind Collection brings together the ultimate collection of Tommy, Chuckie, Phil, Lil, and Angelica’s greatest hits. Curated for fans by the team at Limited Run Games, this nostalgic bundle restores six iconic adventures from the Golden Age of Reptar, now enhanced for modern play.

Whether you're exploring the Pickles' backyard or trekking through EuroReptarland, this is the definitive way to experience the games that defined a generation of Nicktoons fans.

name: Little Helper Cafe: Sugar Cubes
summary: Small Deliveries, Big Smiles

name: Mogitate: Bearing Fruit
summary: You're a spirited young man, ready to make the most of a new start! Meet the colorful cast of townsfolk and live your life to the fullest while making friends with all of the people around you!

name: Retro Collection: 3 in 1
summary: Three timeless classics. Endless retro fun.

name: Block Run
summary: BLOCK RUN is a fast, minimalist grid-based dodge game where you play as a single square racing to the far side of the arena across 10 quick levels. Each stage is a short, high-pressure run on a live grid. Enemy blocks move left and right in predictable “ping-pong” paths, with some resetting automatically, pushing you to judge timing, bait openings, and slip through at the exact moment; no extra assets, no distractions—just pure top-down arcade precision and rapid retries.

name: Suisaiga ha Suitei ni Shizumu
summary: Watercolors Sink Beneath the Surface is a nostalgic pixel-art point-and-click adventure set on Narumi Island, where only an abandoned high school stands. Years later, two girls return to complete a watercolor inspired by their school memories, gathering ideas from the remnants of the past.

name: Mike Goes on Hike
summary: Become a real tourist in Mike Goes on Hike! Amazing wild landscapes, inexpressible atmosphere of hiking and important vital lessons are waiting for you. Go all the way to the end to fulfill the request of your beloved grandfather.

name: Modern Naval Warfare
summary: Modern Naval Warfare is the next generation naval combat simulator, which will immerse you in the dark and unforgiving world of the modern high-tech naval battlefield.

name: Corsairs: Battle of the Caribbean
summary: An immersive adventure and strategy game set amidst the thrilling world of buccaneering. As a shrewd captain, navigate tumultuous seas, engage in complex politics, and manage a diverse crew to establish maritime dominance and ensure your fleet's future.

name: WorldShaper Idle
summary: A tile-based world-building idle game. Place forests, rocks, mystical flowers and much more. Discover new tiles by experimenting with their placement. Then try to use their bonuses to optimize your production, or just sit back and become more powerful! What will your world look like?

name: Panthalassa
summary: Panthalassa is a Point and click and visual novel set in an underwater alien world. You play as an AI trying to uncover the memories of their body's previous owner. The game makes you experience the world through different user interfaces, where the physical and digital worlds collide.

name: Midnight Escape
summary: A weekend getaway turns into a desperate fight for survival. In Midnight Escape, team up with 3 friends to explore a terrifying villa while hunted by a relentless creature. You must find clues, solve intricate puzzles, and find one of the multiple escape routes before the night claims you all.

name: Crush the Rebellion!
summary: The galactic empire is under siege from the rebel scum in all directions! Fight through endless waves of rebel ships using all of the weapons and resources at your disposal as you execute your sole orders: to Crush The Rebellion!

name: It Reaches
summary: It Reaches is a first person horror game, captured through the lens of a police officer’s body cam. Trapped inside the facilities of an abandoned hospital, find a way to escape the horrors lurking underground. Uncover a dark mystery left behind and don't get caught! They will reach for you…

name: Thrifty Business
summary: Run your very own thrift shop in this laid-back management sim! Sort through boxes to find hidden treasures and arrange nostalgic displays of clothes, antiques, toys & more. Befriend the regulars, help with their requests and expand your store into a hub for the local community!

name: Re:Blade
summary: Re:Blade is a cursor-driven action roguelike with incremental progression. Control your positioning while attacks fire automatically, shape your build through Awakenings, and face sudden boss invasions.

name: Game.exe 2: Phantom Strike
summary: You find an old computer with a forgotten program installed: Phantom Strike. A single server is still online, frozen in time and waiting for someone to finish the match. What begins as nostalgic curiosity becomes a descent into something far stranger.

name: Dwarf Eats Mountain
summary: Dwarves hunger for gold, and no mountain shall stand in their way! Mine riches, unearth artifacts, and upgrade your dwarves to devour ever-bigger peaks in this whimsical incremental game.

name: Shikhondo: Blue Pieta
summary: Once more, the hunt for Youkai begins! Across the ocean in a city far, far away, the side-scrolling shoot 'em up action of our two protagonists unfolds! Complete the Pietà of struggle that burns blue with its raging barrage!

name: Add Flyers To Dreams
summary: Would you like to run ads in dreams? “ADD FLYERS TO DREAMS” is a flappy roguelike game where you fly around inside dreams, inject ads, stack up contracts, and earn cookies.

name: At Night: Haunted Ride
summary: The grand opening of the Haunted Mine Ride is tomorrow. Tonight, you run the final test rides. Ride the minecart, Fix props, repeat rides and don’t make "them" notice you.

name: Frostland
summary: Click, collect, build and craft. Frostland is a cozy 2D clicker game set in a snowy valley. Process resources and forge powerful tools to help Pitty, the wizard dog, on his journey to obtain the legendary staff.

name: I Want You To Notice Me: His Story
summary:
It's Spot the Differences game.…. until someone changes how you see everything

I Want You To Notice Me is a short 5-minute but charming spot-the-difference game that’s a little more meaningful than it first appears.

The rules aren’t always what you expect.
Sometimes they change—depending on the situation… and the feelings behind it.

But don’t worry.
Just relax, take your time, and enjoy the story.

name: Rune Dice
summary: Throw dice, create explosive chain reactions, and defeat waves of enemies in Rune Dice! Collect ancient runes with diverse abilities, add synergies between relics, heroes, and special dice. All combined, this will give you an excellent experience in our roguelike deckbuilder.

name: Forza Horizon 6
summary: Discover the breathtaking landscapes of Japan in over 550 real-world cars and become a racing Legend at the Horizon Festival. Start your journey as a tourist and explore a world full of hit music and Japanese culture. Build a Valley Estate, acquire awe-inspiring homes, and display your prized car collection in fully Customizable Garages. Cruise the roads with your friends and join Car Meets around Japan, unleash your imagination with EventLab and build together in Horizon CoLab.

name: Winnie-the-Pooh Hops for Honey
summary: Uh oh. Winnie-the-Pooh ate all of the honey that Christopher Robin set aside for the annual Honey Festival! It's up to Winnie to set things right and prove that his heart is bigger than his stomach by adventuring into the Hundred Acre Wood to collect enough honey to save the festival!

name: R-Type Dimensions III
summary: Building on the legacy of R-Type Dimensions and R-Type Dimensions EX, Dimensions III has been completely re-envisioned with cutting-edge visuals and sounds, expanded gameplay modes, and a range of new features designed to deliver the most definitive modern edition of R-Type’s classic era.

name: Caravan Village: Farming Life
summary: Turn a scam into an empire! In Caravan Village, farm crops, raise animals, mine for resources, and renovate abandoned caravans into luxury suites. Recover your grandma's lost cookbook, cook delicious meals, and charm your guests in this open-ended life RPG. Create your own vacation paradise!

name: Pix Football Manager
summary: PIX Football Manager is a nostalgic, casual football management simulator focused on scouting. Set your tactics, find hidden gems, and improve your facilities as you build a dynasty. With no visible player stats, you must spot talent yourself. Grab your clipboard, the game starts now.

name: Farming Simulator 26: Nintendo Switch Edition
summary: Rise to the Challenge of Farming!
